exact_theorem.basis_invariance: nonsingular column changes preserve a finite column space
exact_theorem.finite_scope: all identities concern declared finite matrices
exact_theorem.nested_model_monotonicity: a panel-shared column space is contained in the panel-adaptive block space
exact_theorem.prediction_definition: least-squares coefficient trained on source panels and evaluated on a held-out panel

protocol.hostile_control_loo: fresh-panel target uses one omitted control and nuisance means over the other eight controls
protocol.panel_adaptive_model: one nuisance coefficient vector per panel
protocol.shared_model: one nuisance coefficient vector across all three panels

weightings.equal_row: each row divided by its twin-target L2 norm
